findings.title: Type narrowing breaks callers that pass integers
findings.body: The new signature restricts `sku` to `str`, but `stockroom/receiving.py` line 12 calls `normalize_sku(barcode)` with an `int` from `barcodes: list[int]`. This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Either restore the union type `str | int` or convert the integer to a string before calling.

findings.title: Redundant type check after narrowing
findings.body: The function now enforces `isinstance(sku, str)` even though the signature already restricts the parameter to `str`. This check is redundant and clutters the function body. Remove it to keep the code concise.

summary.problem: The new signature breaks existing callers and adds an unnecessary runtime check.
summary.done_well: The docstring clearly describes the function’s purpose and canonical form.
